releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.1.8

Hubble 1.1.8: Stream Deck layouts and reliable workspace exports

Add Companion Layout with device previews for Stream Deck XL, MK.2, Mini, Neo, +, + XL, and Studio. Edit key and dial assignments, fill empty slots, customize numbering, and save reusable layout presets while preserving existing navigation and other controls.

Include Companion module 0.3.4 with automatic position-based button numbering and saved page numbering settings.

Wait for pending workspace and connection edits before exporting. Preserve every saved module connection, including unused connections, when importing complete configurations. Fix skipped queued workspace operations and ambiguous import mappings.
